rv.q: “It’s right and good that Brant reminds us of her success in a segregated and sexist America, as well as her struggles to balance missionary zeal with a taste for raunch that saw her shunned by her own church.
What makes Marie and Rosetta a joyous entertainment are the songs, the band, and the incredible voices of these two amazing singers.
The songs come thick and fast and are all a delight.
The songs, and Monique Touko’s direction of them, help restore momentum, elevating a sometimes static script into something resonant and musically vibrant.

cn.t: Critics agree Marie & Rosetta is a joyful, overdue tribute to rock's forgotten godmother, elevated by two powerhouse performances and electrifying music.
